events.text:
All 10 batches are migrated: 400 records are in the new CRM.

**Issue:** The old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM prefixed every number with +1. At least 31 of the first 120 records are overseas customers, so those numbers are wrong. Batches 4–10 have the same defect; I do not have a count for them. 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours and may already be using the bad numbers.

I did not change any phones. I do not have the correct numbers, and guessing prefixes would make it worse. Send the correct overseas numbers (customer id and full number) and I will update them.
